crypto.conservative_definition: bar N trigger checks use the stop known before bar N; bar N high-water observation activates on bar N+1
crypto.method: path-level conservative production ordering plus explicit optimistic and worst-case sensitivity variants against both runtime execution identities; stateful replay remains the primary M2M result
crypto.optimistic_definition: same-bar high updates the stop before that bar's low trigger check; diagnostic only and not admissible for activation
crypto.worst_definition: existing stop triggers at the bar low, including gap-through loss; diagnostic stress only
